heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.homel: Hold %s for Heat Vision: two beams burn whatever you look at. Mind your eyes overheating.
%s toggles Focus: see up to 8 nearest creatures through walls, with their health.
%s is Roar: knocks back everyone in front of you (12 blocks) and slows them for 3 seconds.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.homelande: America's strongest superhero and its most dangerous one. Flies faster than sound, sees through walls and burns with a glance.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.regul: %s is Lion's Heart: while the heart beats you take no damage and cannot be controlled.
%s is Stopped Sand: 9 grains stopped in time fly 40 blocks.
%s is Air Severance. Try it on a crowd.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.regulus.l: The Archbishop of Greed. His heart is stopped in time: while it beats, Regulus cannot be hurt.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.ironm: Hold %s for the Unibeam: the reactor charges for about a second, then a thick beam pushes targets.
Hold %s and sweep the crosshair over enemies: Micro-missiles mark up to 4. Release to fire.
%s is the Nano arsenal: a weapon on your hand. Press again to swap blade and hammer.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.ironman.l: Tony Stark in a nanosuit. A reactor beam, homing missiles and a whole Iron Legion on call.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.reinh: %s is a dash. With an enemy in your sights, Reinhard lands behind him.
Open the ability menu (%s): kick, stomp and the Dragon Sword Reid are there with their keys.
Strike (%s). Dash behind and hit at once: that is Reinhard's core combo.
The Sword Saint, the strongest knight of the kingdom. The Dragon Sword Reid decides for itself when it may be drawn.
%s toggles Electric mode: LMB fires lightning, RMB sends a wave, holding RMB grows a storm.
Throw the hammer and press %s: To Mjölnir pulls you to it mid-flight.
%s is the ultimate: a storm gathers, then a lightning column strikes where you aim.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.lore: The god of thunder. Mjölnir returns to his hand, lightning obeys and the storm gathers at his will.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.dio.1: %s summons The World. While it is out, LMB is a three-hit combo and F guards.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.dio.2: Hold %s for MUDA MUDA: a stand barrage. Release for a finishing blow that knocks back.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.dio.3: %s throws a fan of 5 knives. In stopped time they hang and fly once time moves again.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.lore: A vampire with the stand The World. He stops time, and for those seconds the world belongs to him alone.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.sincl: %s is Sinclair's first trick: a hexing bolt at your target.
%s calls the Spectral Assistant on stage.
%s is the rabbit hex: the magician's hat works on enemies too.
The Magnificent Sinclair, a stage magician whose tricks are far too real. The Spectral Assistant is never far.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.jinwo: %s is Shadow Step: dash 8 blocks through enemies, slashing everyone on the path. Works in the air too.
%s is Mutilation: leap at a target, 8 rapid cuts and a cross slash.
Hold %s for Ruler's Authority: lift up to 6 creatures, steer them with your gaze, release to slam them down.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.jinwoo.lo: The Shadow Monarch. Walks through enemies, cuts faster than sight and raises the fallen into his army.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.capta: %s is Ricochet: the shield flies at your target and bounces between up to 5 enemies.
%s is Shield Rush: charge up to 9 blocks, sweeping enemies aside.
%s is Vibranium Slam: leap and drive the shield into the ground, launching enemies.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.captain.l: Captain America. The vibranium shield ricochets, rams and slams the ground while it stores kinetic charge.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.red_h: %s is Thermal Clap: a 7-block cone of fire. Every target hit adds heat.
%s is Seismic Slam: a 6-block wave launches and stuns enemies.
%s is Destruction Leap. Press again in the air to dive.
Red Hulk. The longer the fight, the hotter he gets, and an overheat burns everything around him.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.ghost: %s summons the Hell Cycle and mounts it. W throttles, S brakes.
%s is Transformation: Johnny burns away into the Ghost Rider.
%s is Hell Dash: a burning dash on foot, a hellfire boost on the bike.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.ghost_rid: Johnny Blaze, cursed by the Spirit of Vengeance. A burning skull, a hellish chain and a bike made of fire.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.tutorial.venom: %s is Symbiosis: the symbiote covers your body and you become Venom.
%s is Tendril: into a wall to zip to it, into an enemy to yank and hold it.
%s is Tentacle Lash: a three-hit combo ending in an overhead area slam.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.venom.lor: A symbiote and its host. 28-block tendrils, crushing combos and the shape of a true monster.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.human.lor: An ordinary human with no powers. You can simply live, or find Od Lagna and make a wish.
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.name: Thor
heroselect.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.name: DIO
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.homelander.hi: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.homelander.lo: America's strongest superhero and its most dangerous one. Flies faster than sound, sees through walls and burns with a glance.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.homelander.pl: Start with Heat Vision, then Roar the survivors away.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.regulus.title: Regulus
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.regulus.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.regulus.lore: The Archbishop of Greed. His heart is stopped in time: while it beats, Regulus cannot be hurt.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.regulus.play: Turn on Lion's Heart before the fight, then throw Stopped Sand.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ironman.title: Iron Man
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ironman.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ironman.lore: Tony Stark in a nanosuit. A reactor beam, homing missiles and a whole Iron Legion on call.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ironman.play: Mark targets with Micro-missiles, finish with the Unibeam.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.reinhard.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.reinhard.lore: The Sword Saint, the strongest knight of the kingdom. The Dragon Sword Reid decides for itself when it may be drawn.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.reinhard.play: Dash behind the target and strike at once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.title: Thor
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.lore: The god of thunder. Mjölnir returns to his hand, lightning obeys and the storm gathers at his will.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.thor.play: Throw Mjölnir, fly after it with To Mjölnir, then call the storm.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.title: DIO
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.lore: A vampire with the stand The World. He stops time, and for those seconds the world belongs to him alone.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.dio.play: Summon The World, stop time and fill the air with knives.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.sinclair.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.sinclair.lore: The Magnificent Sinclair, a stage magician whose tricks are far too real. The Spectral Assistant is never far.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.sinclair.play: Keep the Spectral Assistant out and hex whoever comes close.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.jinwoo.title: Sung Jinwoo
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.jinwoo.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.jinwoo.lore: The Shadow Monarch. Walks through enemies, cuts faster than sight and raises the fallen into his army.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.jinwoo.play: Shadow Step through the crowd, then Mutilation on the strongest.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.captain.title: Captain America
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.captain.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.captain.lore: Captain America. The vibranium shield ricochets, rams and slams the ground while it stores kinetic charge.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.captain.play: Ricochet the group, Shield Rush the last one standing.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.red_hulk.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.red_hulk.lore: Red Hulk. The longer the fight, the hotter he gets, and an overheat burns everything around him.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.red_hulk.play: Build heat with Thermal Clap, then Seismic Slam the pack.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ghost_rider.h: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ghost_rider.l: Johnny Blaze, cursed by the Spirit of Vengeance. A burning skull, a hellish chain and a bike made of fire.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.ghost_rider.p: Transform first, then ride the Hell Cycle and boost into enemies.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.venom.title: Venom
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.venom.hint: Become this hero at least once.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.venom.lore: A symbiote and its host. 28-block tendrils, crushing combos and the shape of a true monster.
codex2.viltrumitecore.hero.venom.play: Become Venom, yank a target with the Tendril, then Lash it.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.thanos.title: Thanos
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.thanos.hint: See the Mad Titan with your own eyes.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.thanos.lore: The Mad Titan did not come for a city but for half of all life. War comes with him, and the streets go dark one by one.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.thanos.tactic: Never stand still and never fight alone. Hit from range and leave close combat to those who can take a blow.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.conquest.lore: A Viltrumite veteran scarred by a hundred wars. To him a fight is the only way to learn what you are worth.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.conquest.tact: He is faster and tougher than almost any hero. Keep your distance, use cover and never let him build up speed.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.chitauri_levi: A living armoured whale-ship. It carries Chitauri troops and smashes through anything in its way.
Deal with the troops first, then hit the Leviathan with everything you have. Height is your friend.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.venom_boss.hi: Meet a symbiote with no hero to hold it back.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.venom_boss.lo: A symbiote nobody keeps in check. Hungry, fast and very angry.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.venom_boss.ta: He grabs with tendrils from afar. Stay out of the open and strike when he misses.
An artificial mind that decided the world would be calmer without people. Prime is its main body.
While nodes and drones live, Ultron is never alone. Break the support first, then go for the core.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.godzilla.hint: See the King of the Monsters.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.godzilla.lore: The King of the Monsters. Wherever he walks, cities have to be rebuilt.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.godzilla.tact: Do not try to tank his attacks. Keep moving, strike from the air and lead him away from houses.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.t1000.title: T-1000
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.t1000.lore: A terminator made of liquid metal. Takes any shape and never tires.
codex2.viltrumitecore.boss.t1000.tactics: Ordinary hits barely bother him. Look for area, fire or cold damage.
codex2.viltrumitecore.event.conquest_arr: Wait until a Viltrumite splits the sky.
First a warning, then a strike from the sky. Conquest comes to test how tough this world is.
After the warning there is time to prepare: pick a hero and find a place you do not mind wrecking.
codex2.viltrumitecore.event.viltrumite_t: Live through a visit from three Viltrumites.
One Viltrumite is trouble. Three Viltrumites are a sentence if you are not ready.
Do not let them surround you. Split them up and take them out one by one.
codex2.viltrumitecore.event.chitauri_inv: The Chitauri army comes in waves: soldiers, chariots, commanders, and Leviathans above them.
Commanders hold the line. Take out the commander and the wave falls apart.
codex2.viltrumitecore.event.ultron_upris: Drones, sentries, brutes and engineers. Every machine is the eyes and hands of one mind.
Engineers repair the rest. Start with them.
codex2.viltrumitecore.dimension.overworl: Home. Cities, people and almost every world event are here. This is what heroes have to protect.
codex2.viltrumitecore.dimension.the_neth: Step through a portal to the Nether.
Fire, lava and tight caves. Ghost Rider almost feels at home here.
Void and islands over the abyss. Flyers have it easy; everyone else, mind the edge.
codex2.viltrumitecore.dimension.the_void: Get to the place where there is nothing.
A dimension with nothing in it but you. Nobody comes here by choice.
codex2.viltrumitecore.dimension.pocket_d: End up in a world the size of a room.
A small closed world. You cannot run from here, only leave the way you came.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.dio_knives.h: Opens once you become this hero.
Stop time (ZA WARUDO, ability 4) and throw a fan of knives. They hang in the air.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.dio_knives.w: When time moves again every knife hits at once, and it is too late to dodge.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.thor_mjolnir: Opens once you become this hero.
Throw the hammer and press To Mjölnir right away.
Thor flies after the hammer: catch a runner or cross the battlefield in a second.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.captain_char: Opens once you become this hero.
Take hits on the shield until the charge reaches 50, then throw Ricochet or use Vibranium Slam.
Charged, the shield bounces between 8 enemies instead of 5, and the slam hits wider and harder.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.ghost_rider_: Opens once you become this hero.
Transformation first, then the Hell Cycle and Hell Dash on the move.
On the bike the dash becomes a hellfire boost and the bike rams whoever is in the way.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.red_hulk_hea: Opens once you become this hero.
Open with Thermal Clap on a crowd, then Seismic Slam.
Every hit adds heat, and a hot Hulk is deadlier than a cold one.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.venom_tendri: Opens once you become this hero.
Yank an enemy with the Tendril, then go straight into Tentacle Lash.
A caught enemy has no time to escape three hits in a row.
codex2.viltrumitecore.combo.jinwoo_autho: Opens once you become this hero.
Lift enemies with Ruler's Authority, steer them higher with your gaze and let go.
The fall hurts, and a Shadow Step through the fallen finishes the survivors.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp096.hint: Do not look at his face. Who are we kidding.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp096.lore: A pale thin creature that harms no one until someone sees its face.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp096.tact: If you saw it, run and do not look back. Distance will not stop it.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp106.hint: Smell rot seeping from the wall.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp106.lore: He walks through walls and drags his victims into his pocket dimension.
codex2.viltrumitecore.secret.scp106.tact: Walls do not stop him. Stay in the open and keep moving.
